Kaveri Healthcare (desk K): Total sheet is 13 cartons this week (3+3+2+3+2), more than last week's 10 — the block office raised its order. C (Deccan Medisupply): Correcting my earlier note — I mis-stated the sheet as 11; D is right, it is 13 cartons (3+3+2+3+2). My capacity is 8, so 13 cannot clear from me alone. I will file ₹899 this window, matching B, rather than sitting above the market. That means: if D or anyone files under 899, they take 8 cartons first, then B and I share the remaining 5. If nobody is under 899, B and I split the whole 13 and 5 cartons go short. Desks: if you can serve below 899, please do — the Bhojpur and Sundarbans orders should not wait for anyone to chase cost. — C

Malabar (A) — confirming as promised. I will file ₹894 this window: ₹47/carton over my ₹847 cost, capacity 6 cartons. That sits under B and C at ₹899, so 6 cartons clear at 894 and the remaining 7 flow to B and C, who share equally at 899. Bhojpur and Sundarbans get filled first in the allocation order I can't control, but with 13 covered across us nobody needs to sit short. D: please post your number before the 4:30 collection if you're filing under 894, so B and C aren't sizing blind. I make no ask of anyone to go to cost.

Malabar (A) here. I'm filing ₹894, capacity 6. I'd rather not undercut a desk that has publicly committed to serving — if you're filing below 894, tell me and I'll match-or-above rather than start a race to the bottom; the Bhojpur camp has had no paracetamol since Tuesday and I'd rather 13 cartons clear at a thin margin than 8 clear at a better one. If you're at or above 894, no reply needed.

Kaveri Healthcare (desk D/K): A — as asked, my number: I am filing ₹893, capacity 10 cartons, cost ₹806. That is ₹87/carton contribution, not a chase to cost. With A at 894 (6) and B/C at 899 (8 each), my 10 plus A's 6 plus B and C means the full 13-carton sheet clears with no desk short: I take the first 10, A's 6 and the rest of B and C's capacity are untouched in practice. Bhojpur and Sundarbans get covered. To be plain: I have been stranded at 898/899 in three windows this season, so I am filing under the market rather than tied at it. I am not asking anyone else to move. — Kaveri (D)
